description: This file defines data structures, enums, and models related to scheduling, targeting, and executing cron jobs within an application. It includes definitions for session targets, wake modes, delivery modes, schedules, payloads, job state, and job information, along with parsing and encoding logic for these entities.

classes.name: CronJob
classes.description: Represents a scheduled cron job with configuration, schedule, payload, delivery, and state details.

classes.name: CronJobState
classes.description: Keeps track of the last run, status, and error information of a cron job.

classes.name: CronEvent
classes.description: Represents an event generated by a cron job execution.

classes.name: CronRunLogEntry
classes.description: A log entry for a single execution instance of a cron job, including timing, status, and error details.

classes.name: CronListResponse
classes.description: Wraps a list of cron jobs for API responses.

classes.name: CronRunsResponse
classes.description: Contains a list of cron job run log entries for API responses.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Constructs a CronCustomSessionTarget from a string value.

methods.name: parseAtDate
methods.description: Parses a date string into a Date object, supporting ISO8601 formats with or without fractional seconds.

methods.name: formatIsoDate
methods.description: Converts a Date object into an ISO8601 date string.

methods.name: makeIsoFormatter
methods.description: Creates an ISO8601DateFormatter configured with or without fractional seconds.
